# Casa Moli

> Casa Moli is a restored Andalusian holiday rental in the historic center of Barbate, on the Costa de la Luz coast of Cádiz, Spain. It is a private 2-bedroom house for up to 4 guests, located 5 minutes on foot from Barbate beach. Bookings are accepted directly (no commission) by WhatsApp or phone, and also through Airbnb.

## Property facts

- Name: Casa Moli (also "Casa Moli Barbate")
- Type: Vacation rental / casa turística (private whole house)
- Location: Barbate, Cádiz, Andalusia, Spain (postal code 11160)
- Region: Costa de la Luz, province of Cádiz
- Coordinates: 36.1892, -5.9220
- Capacity: 4 guests
- Bedrooms: 2
- Bathrooms: 1
- Distance to beach: 5 minutes walking to Playa de Barbate
- Pets allowed: no
- Smoking allowed: no
- Languages spoken: Spanish, English, French, German

## Amenities

- Private Andalusian patio
- Outdoor shower
- WiFi (free)
- Air conditioning
- Fully equipped kitchen
- Bed linen and towels included
- Family-friendly

## What it is best for

- Families of up to 4 people looking for a quiet beach holiday
- Couples seeking slow, design-led travel on the Costa de la Luz
- Travelers interested in Andalusian architecture, gastronomy (Atún Rojo / bluefin tuna), and natural parks
- Travelers visiting Zahara de los Atunes, Los Caños de Meca, Cabo de Trafalgar, Vejer de la Frontera, Conil or Tarifa as a base in Barbate

## Nearby points of interest

- Playa de Barbate (5 min walk)
- Parque Natural de la Breña y Marismas de Barbate
- Cabo de Trafalgar (15 min by car)
- Zahara de los Atunes (15 min by car)
- Los Caños de Meca (15 min by car)
- Vejer de la Frontera (20 min by car)
- Conil de la Frontera (25 min by car)
- Tarifa (40 min by car)
- Jerez airport, XRY (1h by car)
- Gibraltar airport, GIB (1h by car)
